Six ingredients, nothing hidden

Every batch is rolled by hand in small trays, so the mix stays coarse and the honey never cooks out. We buy the oats and flaxseed from two family mills in Yorkshire and press the coconut oil ourselves.

  • Jumbo rolled oats
  • Raw wildflower honey
  • Golden flaxseed
  • Cold-pressed coconut oil
  • Madagascan vanilla
  • Sea salt

Free from refined sugar, palm oil and preservatives. Made in a kitchen that also handles tree nuts.
